meta.stacking: simplex grid step 0.25 chosen on the 10% inner mask for every combo (2-6 components; first argmin in itertools.product order); extra row knn_lr_ad_cs_bpca_gcn__nnls = unconstrained non-negative least squares of the 6 components on the inner mask
meta.relative_metric: RMSE / RMSE(champion); headline = mean over the 12 target x mask cells of the seed-averaged RMSE ratio (phasec.summarize convention); split-level also given
